timing_policy.outliers: all original samples retained; no post-hoc filtering
timing_policy.actual_clock_verification: not inferred from the configured ceiling

export.path_policy: Workspace paths are relative to the repository root, not this JSON directory.
export.retention: All original timing statistics, samples and historical-reference labels are preserved.
export.evidence_policy: Evidence objects inline original JSON data; source SHA256 refers to original bytes before path normalization.

data.scope: all six unified FWD/BWD entry specializations per model

data.window: first launch start through completion marker mtime
limitations: Launch windows include initialization, warmup, checks and idle time.
Power >= 300 W is only a load filter, not kernel timestamp alignment.
Sampling cannot establish clocks for individual sub-millisecond kernels.
Samples outside the final matrix window are excluded.

notes: Main BWD and Flex are historical references.
Current Qwen EP8/8K has mean/p50 direction differences; do not claim robust gain.
EP16 BWD aggregated JSON lacks warmup field; original raw logs/test source remain authoritative.
